pages.text: $(italic)Storage Drawers$() upgrades emit a comparator-style signal:$(br)$(li)$(bold)Redstone Upgrade$() — total fullness.$(li)$(bold)Min Redstone Upgrade$() — the least-full slot.$(li)$(bold)Max Redstone Upgrade$() — the most-full slot.$(br2)Drop one in a drawer and wire restocking to it.
pages.title: Drawer Signals

pages.text: $(italic)Tom's Simple Storage$() adds the $(bold)Level Emitter$() — it emits a redstone signal based on how much of a chosen item the storage network holds. Network-wide stock control in one block.
pages.title: Level Emitter
